summary: On both known transport_failure and simulated outcome_unknown from the real volatile fixture Registration.registerTeacher service, createPublicController.syncRuntime replaces the valid pre-call registration.identity with empty identity because the fixture snapshot remains unregistered. The registration route and form remain, school selection and terms acceptance persist, but rendered name/email/phone fields and controller identity are blank. A retryable known failure has no safe public:retry handler; manual re-entry/resubmit succeeds and the second synthetic alias is used for login. The valid control succeeds; fixture provider state has no registration after either injected failure. No product source was changed.

observations.validControl: pending registration; completed request; form replaced by pending view
observations.knownFailure: route register, request failed, outcomeKnown true, retryable true; controller identity fields empty and rendered form fields blank; school and terms retained; provider registration none and session anonymous

observations.resubmit: manual re-entry succeeded on registration attempt 2; observed synthetic alias indices [1,2]; after simulated approval, login used alias index 2 and restored the entered synthetic email
